intro: Newport Tower is the Grade A office component of Newport Plaza at 80 Anson Road, in District 2, developed by City Developments Limited. CDL’s construction page, current as at 2 November 2026 and as recorded in our project file, lists an indicative TOP in the fourth quarter of 2027 for the mixed development. That is an expected completion, not an obtained TOP. A CDL first-half 2026 investor presentation, as noted in the file, records a 220,000 sq ft Grade A office component. This page covers the office tower only. Newport Residences and the Newport Plaza retail podium are the other components of the same parent development and should not be counted again here. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Newport Tower fit-out.

sections.heading: Planning your Newport Tower interior
sections.text:
The useful conversation with Maison, once a floor plate is available, is an office fit-out, not a home renovation: a reception joinery wall, workstation storage, meeting-room carpentry, and a pantry run, specified as built-in work rather than as loose, flat-pack furniture. We can present that in a wide floor view or in closer studies of a reception desk or a pantry. No official floor plate is on file, so typical floor typologies and headcount are left blank. Views over the city or the older Tanjong Pagar grain should be checked from the actual floor and facing, not assumed from the address.

The retail podium, in this batch, and Newport Residences, packed earlier, are the correct cross-links. Keppel South Central, 39 Robinson Road and Shaw Tower are nearby office and central links. We will not invent walking times to Anson Road or to the waterfront.

When an indicative handover is in writing, work backwards from it: landlord fit-out manual, measured survey, landlord and fire-safety approvals, then fabrication. A moderate office joinery scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee, and a multi-floor workplace can take longer. WhatsApp Maison with your floor plate when you have it. We are not affiliated with CDL.

faq.q: When is TOP or opening at Newport Tower?
faq.a: Our project file records: 2027-Q4 indicative TOP. Where the note says indicative, targeted or expected, treat it as an estimate, not an obtained TOP or an opening day.

faq.q: Do you have a floor plan for Newport Tower?
faq.a: No official floor plan or tenancy / floor-plate drawing is on file for this page, so none is published here. Please send your approved tenancy or office plan.

No. The copy is angled at shop, office or F&B fit-out. Send a tenancy plan and permitted trade, not a residential brief, unless you actually have a home in a related development — in which case use that development’s own page.
